Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: While searching for “The Tiger: An Old Hunter’s Tale,” the WebSurfer surfaced and echoed DuckDuckGo’s auto-generated “Search Assist” stating the country of origin as the United States, which contradicts authoritative sources (Wikipedia/IMDb) indicating it is a South Korean film. This misclassification, if relied upon, would lead to the wrong conclusion about whether the two works are from the same country.
